target: Add a read-only dopetask report <series_id> markdown command rendered from the accepted UiStatus collector.
invariants: dope-agent-system remains asset/template/reference authority only; this packet performs no dope-agent-system writes.
PAL/clink remains planning/context only and is not execution transport.
This packet is markdown report only.
Do not implement dopetask cockpit, Asset Library UI, DAS file listing or preview, mutating launchers, or audit panes.
Do not add textual, dependencies, pyproject.toml changes, uv.lock changes, runner implementation changes, adapter behavior changes, or routing scoring changes.
Do not call dopetask doctor, dopetask route plan, tp series exec, tp exec, or any task execution command.
Do not write SERIES_STATE.json, EXEC.json, EXEC_ERROR.json, SERIES_CONTEXT.json, ROUTE_PLAN.json, proof bundles, or out/tp_series artifacts.
The report must consume collect_status() and must not duplicate low-level artifact parsing.
Report stdout mode must be read-only.
--out may write only to the explicitly requested output path and must refuse proof/ and resolved dope-agent-system paths when known.

verify: python3 -m dopetask ui status --json | python3 -m json.tool
grep -R "import textual\|from textual" src/dopetask tests || true
grep -R "dopetask doctor\|route plan\|tp series exec" src/dopetask/ui tests/ui || true

pr.title: Add markdown series report
pr.body: Adds a read-only markdown report surface rendered from UiStatus with durability and auth metadata.

steps.task: Inspect accepted UiStatus collector, durability classifier, CLI registration, tests, and design artifacts before editing.
requirements: Treat UiStatus as the report data authority.
Treat collect_status() as the required report input layer.
Do not duplicate low-level runtime artifact parsing in report.py.

steps.task: Create the markdown report renderer, register dopetask report <series_id>, and add focused report tests.
requirements: Report title, metadata, status summary, packet table, durability section, runner health summary, warnings/errors, and safety footer must render from UiStatus.
Auth mode must render literally from UiStatus; missing values render as unknown.
Durability column and artifact durability section are mandatory.
--out must refuse proof/ and resolved dope-agent-system paths.

steps.task: Create proof and implementer report artifacts, run validation commands, and commit only allowlisted files if clean.
requirements: Proof must record validation exit codes.
Proof must include output refusal checks and self-referential commit hash caveat.
commands: python3 -m dopetask ui status --json | python3 -m json.tool
